verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm that handles client data, so whether client data is used to train AI models is a fair privacy-posture question and the axis applies. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, policy or commitment. The data-protection pages describe legal advisory services to clients, which is an adjacent offering and not a control over the firm's own use of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
